# CANDIDATE: TOM_GAP_FILL_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

SPY exhibits a turn-of-the-month upward bias; when the month-end or early-next-month open gaps down >0.2% and the gap is filled within the first 60 minutes, a long edge emerges. This edge exists because month-end liquidity rebalancing and institutional flows create temporary oversold conditions that revert as new-month buying pressure arrives.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If today is the last trading day of the month or any of the first three trading days of the next month, and the opening price is below the prior day’s close by >0.2% (gap down), go long at the close of the first bar that closes above the prior day’s close within the first 60 minutes of trading.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the low of the gap‑fill bar; target is 1R (risk‑reward) or the prior day’s high, whichever is reached first. Optionally trail with a chandelier exit after 0.5R is achieved. Avoid entry on days with major scheduled events (FOMC, CPI) or when VIX > 30, as gaps tend not to fill in high‑vol regimes.

2. **Sample bias:** No sample yet; proposal is based on turn‑of‑the‑month bias hypothesis and gap‑fill logic. Overfit risk is high until Stage-1 backtest on at least 16 months of data is performed.

5. **Failure modes:** Worst day – gap fails to fill and stops out; max drawdown – consecutive losing gap‑fill days in high‑vol regime; blow‑up scenario – VIX spike >40 with sustained gap‑down days causing repeated stop‑outs.  
6. **Concentration:** Unknown; requires backtest to determine what % of P&L comes from top‑5 days.
